invariants.requirement: Treat created, updated, and unchanged as successful episode outcomes; count is transaction write volume, not a presence or success gate.
After a successful outcome, verify nodes through the type-aware query path a reader will use before marking the source ingested.
Treat timeout, empty response, and gateway errors as indeterminate commit results; verify before any byte-identical retry.
Search before minting and reuse existing node names exactly; a retry must preserve the exact episode body.
Correct one predicate with /set instead of re-posting an episode, because episode merge semantics can append duplicate comments.
Write RDF, RDFS, SKOS, and OWL predicates through /knot or /set; /episode relations are Aegis-local predicates.
Every episode node has a governed type; one untyped node invalidates the whole episode.
